# Automated Extraction of State Transitions in Code

Statically identifies code that mutates tracked state fields (e.g., status or state attributes) in a function, capturing evidence of structural state transitions. This supports understanding of business or process state management within Python modules, primarily for lifecycle or workflow tracking.
